answer: Latency fingerprint registration. Each new identity must answer timed challenges routed through a zephyr of randomized relay paths, and its response timing signature is stored; clones sharing hardware or scheduler produce correlated signatures that cluster on a spiral of measured jitter, so duplicates surface as near-matches without any accusation step. A pearl of consistency is that honest operators pass cheaply, while an attacker must rent genuinely distinct machines with independent timing noise per identity, paying full hardware and maintenance cost for each rather than a marginal fee.
